items.title: Scientists squeeze record-breaking X-ray power into an incredibly tiny spot
items.summary: Scientists have created record-breaking X-ray flashes lasting just 300 attoseconds, concentrating enormous power into an incredibly tiny spot. The breakthrough could unlock a new way to observe electrons in action and potentially control the ultrafast processes that drive chemical reactions.

items.title: Why the tropics lose the most birds when cities expand
